items.description: প্রধানমন্ত্রীর রাজনৈতিক উপদেষ্টা বলেন, শহীদের রক্তের অঙ্গীকার বাস্তবায়নে কার্যকর সংসদ গঠন ও জাতীয় অর্থনীতিকে সচল করাই এখন রাষ্ট্র ও রাজনৈতিক কর্মীদের প্রধান দায়িত্ব।

items.title: National Bank depositors to withdraw money as needed from Oct 15
items.description: National Bank PLC will resume full banking services from October 15, allowing customers to withdraw money according to their needs from all its branches and ATM booths across the country.

items.title: Asia’s coal imports set to surge as LNG stays costly
items.description: Global exports of thermal coal are currently on track to register a second consecutive annual contraction.

items.title: Steelmakers pin hopes on revival of govt projects
items.description: The resumption of public infrastructure projects has raised hopes of a recovery among steelmakers, who have been struggling with weak demand, rising costs and financial pressure.

items.title: Businesses urged to rely less on bank loans
items.description: Bangladesh needs to bring more companies to the stock market and diversify corporate financing beyond bank loans to build a more balanced and resilient financial system, speakers said at a capital market conclave in Dhaka yesterday.

items.title: Subsidised food distribution falls, raising poverty concerns
items.description: Foodgrain distribution at subsidised rates declined in the first quarter of the current fiscal year, mainly because of a fall in open market sales (OMS), raising concerns about the impact on poverty and food security.
